Definition: properly, something weighed out, i.e. (figuratively) a portion of time, i.e. an instance
BiblicalUsage: Moneh is a reckoning, a portion of time — Jacob tells Laban he changed his wages ten times, and counts the years: fourteen years for his two daughters, six years for his cattle, and twenty years in his house.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jacob's counting is the patience of a man who was cheated and kept working: God kept the account, even when Laban did not.
